en.title: Count Binary Substrings
en.description:
Count all contiguous substrings in which the number of 0s equals the number of 1s and that consist of exactly one block of identical characters immediately followed by one block of the other character. Identical content at different positions is counted separately.

The input format, examples, and test data were compiled and written by CSWork; see the statement for the original source and the limits added by this site.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty binary string s. The original MDX gives no length constraint or empty-string rule; this site adds 1≤|s|≤200000.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying substrings as an exact decimal integer (an integer type of at least 64 bits is required).
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying notes for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Compress the string into the run lengths of adjacent characters. Each pair of adjacent runs with lengths p and q yields min(p,q) qualifying substrings.
